description: Start a named child agent on a task. It works in the background with its own fresh context and reports back when it is done; the call returns at once. Use it for work that can go on by itself while you do something else: an independent investigation, a review of a change it didn't write, or a self-contained change. Do small or tightly linked steps yourself, and don't let two agents edit the same files. The child sees only its task, the project's instructions and what it finds itself, never your conversation, so write the task as a complete brief: the goal, the facts and files that matter, what to leave alone and what to hand back. It has your endpoint, model, effort and tools by default, except that it can't ask the user (it asks you instead); endpoint, model and effort may change that, tools_off and spawn only narrow it, and preset names a set of those choices, which may include instructions for the child's role. Its report arrives later as a message from it: don't poll it, wait for it or redo its work, but carry on with other work or end your reply. To run several children at once, start them in the same reply.

cwd.description: The child's working directory: absolute, under ~/ or relative to yours. Yours when left out.

effort.description: The child's effort. Leave it out to use the preset's, or else yours.

endpoint.description: One of the session's endpoints for the child, by name. Set it only when the user asks for a particular endpoint or provider. Leave it out to use the preset's, or else yours.

keep_warm.description: true if you will message it again after its report; while it idles, Wisp refreshes its prompt cache a limited number of times. End it when you won't.

model.description: Another model for the child, one its endpoint serves. Leave it out to use the preset's, or else yours.

name.description: The child's name, unique among your children for the whole session: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -. Its path is yours plus this name.

preset.description: A preset listed in your <environment>; this call's own fields override its choices.

spawn.description: false stops the child from starting agents of its own.

task.description: The brief: everything the child needs to do the task without your conversation, and what it should hand back.

todos.description: Optional steps of the task, in order; they become the child's starting checklist.

tools_off.description: Names of your tools the child shouldn't have.

name: spawn_agent
